This job serves as the foundation for all others, forming the first step on the road to becoming a legendary warrior. Proficiencies are determined by the primary job skill set.

A brave and chivalrous warrior of unmatched skill. Uses a knight's sword to unleash the Arts of War.

Knight uses strength for primary ability and intelligence for spell casting ability with high health growth and low mana growth.

Unique Class Progressions:
Samurai, Holy Knight, Dark Knight, Soldier
